title: Front End Developer
description:
* ​**Cross-Platform Mobile Development:** Design, build, and maintain robust, feature-rich mobile applications using **React Native** for both iOS and Android.
* ​**Web Application Architecture:** Develop and scale server-rendered and static web applications using **Next.js (App Router / Pages Router)**, React, and TypeScript.
* ​**API Integration & Backend Collaboration:** Architect and consume robust RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and backend services (Node.js, Firebase, PostgreSQL, etc.) to power web and mobile platforms.

title: React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern
description:
### **Build Modern Web Interfaces | Develop Responsive Applications | Gain Real-World Experience**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is looking for creative, motivated, and detail-oriented candidates for the position of React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern. The role involves building responsive, interactive, and user-friendly web applications using React JS and modern frontend technologies. Interns will gain practical exposure to component-based architecture, API integration, state management, and frontend performance optimisation through industry-oriented projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain responsive, interactive user interfaces using React JS.
* Build reusable components and modular frontend application features.
* Convert UI/UX designs and wireframes into functional web interfaces.
* Implement React Hooks, component lifecycle concepts, and state management.
* Integrate REST APIs and handle dynamic application data.
* Apply JavaScript ES6+ features and modern frontend development practices.
* Create responsive layouts compatible with different devices and browsers.
* Perform debugging, testing, and frontend performance optimisation.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, and project teams.
* Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and project planning.
* Maintain technical documentation and contribute to live web development projects.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Understanding of React JS fundamentals and component-based architecture.
* Familiarity with JSX, React Hooks, props, and state management.
* Basic knowledge of JavaScript ES6+ concepts.
* Understanding of REST API integration and JSON data handling.
* Familiarity with responsive web design and CSS frameworks is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of Git and GitHub is preferred.
* Awareness of TypeScript, Redux, or Context API is an added advantage.
* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in frontend development, React JS, and modern web technologies are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: React JS & Frontend Application Development Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* React JS Developer
* Frontend Developer
* UI Developer
* JavaScript Developer
* Web Application Developer
* Junior Frontend Engineer

### **Why Join Us?**

* Modern UI Workflows: Gain hands-on exposure to modular React component architectures, custom hooks, and dynamic state management.
* Real-World API Consumption: Learn how to wire complex backend REST services and JSON feeds into seamless user interfaces.
* Design-to-Code Mastery: Practice translating UI/UX wireframes and Figma designs into clean, responsive HTML/CSS/React layouts across all device form factors.
* Portfolio Development: Build a rich, production-grade frontend project portfolio using modern JavaScript ES6+ standards and Git collaboration toolchains.

### **Apply Now and Start Building Your Career in Frontend Development!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume to hr@wahylab.com
